primary.target: open(D) to close(D+4), raw asset return minus SPY same window
primary.hypothesis: hit rate > 0.50 and Brier < causal prequential climatology

decision_rule.look: one confirmatory look at first weekly close after minimum sample; interim looks exploratory
decision_rule.hit_test: one-sided weekly-block bootstrap lower 95% confidence bound > 0.50
decision_rule.brier_test: weekly-block bootstrap upper 95% confidence bound of paired Brier minus prequential climatology < 0
decision_rule.resampling: 10000 draws, seed 20261006; preserve asset cross-section and overlapping horizons by resampling whole calendar weeks
decision_rule.multiplicity: primary intersection rule; all other variants exploratory; count every attempted variant; no alpha claim from secondary looks

exclusions: protected products/windows (including price warmup and label endpoint)
unavailable target prices remain pending; never impute

labels.equity_5d: open(D) to close(D+4) using pinned XNYS sessions
labels.equity_primary: asset raw return minus SPY raw return
labels.crypto: 13:30Z(D) to 13:30Z(D+1 or D+5); exact Coinbase one-minute candle open, available after candle arrives
labels.ties: return > 0 is UP, zero is not UP; report tie counts
labels.pending: future labels append separately, immutable original PredictionRecord

portfolio.directional_probability: UP uses p_outperform; DOWN uses 1-p_outperform; require directional probability >= 0.55
portfolio.weights: signed p_outperform - 0.50, proportional with 10% name cap and <=100% gross
portfolio.consensus: both reviewed analysts agree; use probability closest to 0.50; disagreements abstain
portfolio.cohorts: 1d and 5d are separate portfolios; allocate 1/5 capital to each 5d daily cohort; SPY hedge also obeys gross and 10% cap
portfolio.spread: fixed preregistered paper assumption, not observed bid/ask; modeled net P&L

climatology: past already observed consensus asset/horizon/population outcomes at decision time; initial 0.50; no future fitted probability
